passage.text: Hi Mom, Dad and Fah,
passage.reading: ˈhaɪ ˈmɑːm, ˈdæd ənd ˈfɑː,

passage.text: I can't believe I've been in Toronto for a month already!
passage.reading: aɪ ˈkænt bɪˈliːv aɪv bɪn ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ fər ə ˈmʌnθ ɔːlˈrɛdi!

passage.text: Sorry I haven't called much; the time difference makes it difficult.
passage.reading: ˈsɑːri aɪ ˈhævənt ˈkɔːld ˈmʌtʃ; ðə ˈtaɪm ˌdɪfrəns ˈmeɪks ɪt ˈdɪfɪkəlt.

passage.text: When it's eight in the morning here, it's seven in the evening in Bangkok.
passage.reading: wɛn ɪts ˈeɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ ˈhɪr, ɪts ˈsɛvən ɪn ði ˈiːvnɪŋ ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: My host family is lovely.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈhoʊst ˈfæməli ɪz ˈlʌvli.

passage.text: Mrs. Miller is a nurse, and Mr. Miller is a high school teacher, just like you, Mom and Dad!
passage.reading: ˈmɪsɪz ˈmɪlər ɪz ə ˈnɜːrs, ənd ˈmɪstər ˈmɪlər ɪz ə ˈhaɪ ˌskuːl ˈtiːtʃər, dʒʌst ˈlaɪk juː, ˈmɑːm ənd ˈdæd!

passage.text: They have two kids and a big dog called Max.
passage.reading: ðeɪ ˈhæv ˈtuː ˈkɪdz ənd ə ˈbɪɡ ˈdɔːɡ ˈkɔːld ˈmæks.

passage.text: Every Sunday, Mr. Miller makes French toast with maple syrup.
passage.reading: ˈɛvri ˈsʌndeɪ, ˈmɪstər ˈmɪlər ˈmeɪks ˈfrɛntʃ ˈtoʊst wɪð ˈmeɪpəl ˈsɪrəp.

passage.text: I think I've already gained two kilos!
passage.reading: aɪ ˈθɪŋk aɪv ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈɡeɪnd ˈtuː ˈkiːloʊz!

passage.text: I'm slowly getting used to the cold.
passage.reading: aɪm ˈsloʊli ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈjuːzd tə ðə ˈkoʊld.

passage.text: Last week, I went to the grocery store by myself for the first time.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈwiːk, aɪ ˈwɛnt tə ðə ˈɡroʊsəri ˌstɔːr baɪ maɪˈsɛlf fər ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈtaɪm.

passage.text: Food is expensive here, and I couldn't find fish sauce anywhere!
passage.reading: ˈfuːd ɪz ɪkˈspɛnsɪv ˈhɪr, ənd aɪ ˈkʊdənt ˈfaɪnd ˈfɪʃ ˌsɔːs ˈɛniwɛr!

passage.text: In the end, I found some at a small Asian shop downtown.
passage.reading: ɪn ði ˈɛnd, aɪ ˈfaʊnd sʌm ət ə ˈsmɔːl ˈeɪʒən ˈʃɑːp ˌdaʊnˈtaʊn.

passage.text: My classes are interesting, but they're very different from my classes in Thailand.
passage.reading: maɪ ˈklæsɪz ər ˈɪntrəstɪŋ, bʌt ðɛr ˈvɛri ˈdɪfərənt frəm maɪ ˈklæsɪz ɪn ˈtaɪlænd.

passage.text: Students talk a lot in class, and the professors want to hear our opinions.
passage.reading: ˈstuːdənts ˈtɔːk ə ˈlɑːt ɪn ˈklæs, ənd ðə prəˈfɛsərz ˈwɑːnt tə ˈhɪr aʊr əˈpɪnjənz.

passage.text: I'm a bit shy, but I'm trying to speak up more.
passage.reading: aɪm ə ˈbɪt ˈʃaɪ, bʌt aɪm ˈtraɪɪŋ tə ˈspiːk ˈʌp ˈmɔːr.

passage.text: I miss you all, and I miss Thai food even more!
passage.reading: aɪ ˈmɪs juː ˈɔːl, ənd aɪ ˈmɪs ˈtaɪ ˈfuːd ˈiːvən ˈmɔːr!

passage.text: Fah, please send me some photos of Mom's cooking!
passage.reading: ˈfɑː, ˈpliːz ˈsɛnd miː sʌm ˈfoʊtoʊz əv ˈmɑːmz ˈkʊkɪŋ!

passage.text: Love,
passage.reading: ˈlʌv,

passage.text: Nam
passage.reading: ˈnɑːm
